name: lerobot-merge
description: Merge N sharded LeRobot datasets (produced by parallel roboto-to-lerobot invocations) into one merged LeRobot dataset. Videos are stream-copy concatenated (no re-encode); parquet column values (episode_index, index, task_index) are reindexed in one pass; tasks are unioned by string; per-feature stats are aggregated. Writes a self-contained merged manifest equivalent to a single-shot conversion manifest — the per-shard collections and intermediate outputs can be safely deleted after the merge without loss of provenance.

parameters.name: shard_invocation_ids
parameters.description: JSON array of conversion invocation IDs, in the order they should be merged. Each ID names a per-invocation prefix in the invocation's data_source dataset, written by the conversion action as '<iv>/combined/' (LeRobot tree), '<iv>/manifest.json', and '<iv>/contract.yaml'. Merge order is load-bearing: aggregate_datasets stacks shards in input order, and the merged manifest's episode_to_event indices are offset accordingly. Example: '["iv_abc", "iv_def"]'. The input_data list on the invocation must include patterns that cover these prefixes (e.g. '<iv>/**') so the platform pre-downloads them into context.input_dir.

parameters.name: parent_collection_id
parameters.description: ID of the parent event collection that was partitioned into sub-collections before fan-out. Stamped onto the merged manifest as collection_id so the merged dataset's provenance matches what a single-shot conversion would produce.

parameters.name: parent_collection_version
parameters.description: Version of the parent collection at partition time. Recorded on the merged manifest as collection_version. If unset, the merged manifest's collection_version is null.

parameters.name: data_files_size_in_mb
parameters.description: Override for lerobot.aggregate_datasets data_files_size_in_mb. If unset, lerobot's default (100) is used.

parameters.name: video_files_size_in_mb
parameters.description: Override for lerobot.aggregate_datasets video_files_size_in_mb. If unset, lerobot's default (200) is used. Set to 0 to force every source video file to be a pure shutil.copy (no MP4 container rewrites).

parameters.name: chunk_size
parameters.description: Override for lerobot.aggregate_datasets chunk_size (max files per chunk-XXX directory). If unset, lerobot's default (1000) is used.
